text: The Grave KnightDefeat Atrexis the Grave Knight in the City of Dalaran for Melisara in Tarren Mill.Within the underbelly of the mage city to the north is a traitor to our kind. A necromancer of disturbing talent. He raises an army of undeath right under the Kirin Tor's nose.\r\n\r\nI care not for the fate of the mage city, $n, but this grave knight spits in the face of everything we Forsaken stand for. Put an end to him. Show him no one is beyond the reach of the Dark Lady.

Gaseous GoldGather $1oa Marsh Gas Vials for Sleebo Fizzlespout.The fuel of the future's not coal, or oil, it's gas, baby! Those marshy ponds to the southwest spew it out by the ton, and I've got just the invention to put it to use--a new type of engine that runs on the stuff. The gas is a real pain to collect, though.\r\n\r\nIf you feel like making a humble contribution to the future of science and industry, why don't you help me get some of that gas? You can see it coming up from vents near the water.

A Darker TruthBring the letter you recovered from Broodmother Valraxx to Muln Earthfury at Skywatcher Plateau.<The Broodmother you just killed is no spider at all, but rather a night elf druid who assumed a twisted animal form. A variety of questions flood your mind about the nature--and purpose--of the spiders at Gloomrise.\r\n\r\nYou notice a note peeking out of the folds of the dead elf's robe. Perhaps this document may answer some of the questions filling your head.>

Foul MagicsGet 10 Bloodstone Amulets for Tor'gan in Hammerfall.I have felt a strangeness in the air... a feeling that simmers in my blood. I had my suspicions. I set off to find the source of my unease and discovered to the west, at Northfold Manor, the residual traces of demonic summoning. As I got close, my blood began to boil and the rage within me grew.$b$bOn the ground I spied an amulet of bloodstone, used to assist in demonic summoning. The one I found was depleted, however. I'll need another to examine, but I dare not return to the manor. Can you bring me some?

Rituals of PowerBring the book Rituals of Power to Tabetha in Dustwallow Marsh.Hm... now that I think about it, I don't have my book!  You see, I had some gambling debts and to pay them off I sold the last copy of Rituals of Power to a member of the clergy....$B$BA member of the Scarlet Brotherhood.  He must have taken it to their library in the Scarlet Monastery in Tirisfal Glades!$B$BIf you want that book, then you'll have to go to the monastery to find it.  And sorry about all the trouble.  I'm not myself these days...

Leonid's LetterDeliver the Sealed Letter to Glix Xizzix in the Undercity.Since you are here, I'd like you to deliver this letter to an old friend of mine in the Undercity. I'd deliver myself but I have a somewhat colorful history with the Dark Lady, and it would be better if a neutral third party made the delivery.

You are looking for a goblin named Glix Xizzix in the Trade Quarter area of the Undercity. I'm sure he'd be happy to compensate you for your time.

<Leonid lets out a low chuckle as he hands you the letter.>

The Cult of the DamnedKill $1oa Dark Neophytes and $2oa Dark Enforcers in Tirisfal Glades.The Scourge are a blight on our lands, and their living servants are the worst of them. The people of Tirisfal have enough to deal with between the mindless dead and the Scarlet Crusade. If you wish to do some good, help me put an end to this scum.

The Battle of AlteracEnter Alterac Valley, defeat the Horde general Drek'thar, and then return to Prospector Stonehewer in the Alterac Mountains.The Explorers' League believes there are artifacts in Alterac Valley, but the Frostwolf orcs won't let us explore.  We can't allow the Horde to stop our scholarly pursuits!  Defeat the Frostwolf general, Drek'Thar.  With him dead, the orcs will lose their edge.$B$BDrek'Thar is in Frostwolf Keep, in the south of Alterac Valley.  Vanquish him, and then return to me.Defeat Drek'thar.

Snargl's SnoutLocate Snargl in the Bristle Hills, kill him, and retrieve his snout for Neza Bloodsnout.Among the cackling inhabitants of the Bristle Hills southwest of here is an elder gnoll by the name of Snargl. The sounds emanating from this particular gnoll are quite unpleasant. Their presence inspires those around, creating a problem for allies and scouts who enter the area.

A trophy as a memento of our having dealt with this most unpleasant gnoll fiend would fit nicely with my collection.

Be swift about it, $n.

Alas, AndorhalBring Araj's Phylactery Shard to High Executor Derrington at the Bulwark, Western Plaguelands.Alas, the time to attack Andorhal and drive out the lich that controls it is upon us!$B$BInside the ruins of the city is where the lich - Araj the Summoner - holds dominion.  He is guarded by numerous Scourge surrounding the remains of city's center, and his personal retinue of guardians attached to him directly is formidable.  You will need numerous allies to even stand a chance of facing him successfully.$B$BDestroy Araj, $n, and bring me a shard from his phylactery as proof!
